notes.title: Happy To Announce We Are Out of Early Access
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Long time no see. 

We hope this message finds you well and in good health. It's been a while since we last spoke, but we're excited to catch up with you today.

We are grateful for your continued support of Aquaculture Land and want to provide an update on the development of the game. A few months ago, we made the decision to return to the development of the game in order to complete the Career Mode. Although our team is smaller than before, we are committed to doing our best to finish the game and move on from the Early Access phase.

You can read our last information on why we halted the development [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/858630/view/2993186408001401260]here[/url].

First of all, We want to express our sincere gratitude to everyone who still supports this game and also to you who provided valuable feedback to help us improve the game. And for our news after hiatus, as our responsibility for the development of Aquaculture Land, we have now completed the game by finishing the Career Mode and are pleased to announce that Aquaculture Land is now exiting the Early Access phase.

The Career Mode content is the continuation of the story from the last demo, as you meet and work with the seven characters who will help you on your journey to becoming a successful fish farmer. We've also refined certain features that previously lacked tutorials, and have now included them in the Career Mode.

In this released version, we have also added new customer requests. There will be more varied requests that you'll need to complete to increase your bond level with customers so you can continue your journey. With all that features and challenges, the Career Mode offers approximately 10 to 15 hours of gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/f54e0fc19c1a7d6ac4ae2535b300a842fa2dbaa1.gif[/img]

We understand that we may not have been able to address all of your feedback in this release, and for that, we apologize. However, your critiques and suggestions have been invaluable in helping us to learn and grow as we developed Aquaculture Land.

In conclusion, we want to thank you again for your patience and support as we worked toward this released version. Thank you for your feedback, suggestions, reviews, and, of course, for purchasing and playing Aquaculture Land. We hope that the Career Mode in version 1.0 provides an enjoyable gameplay experience.

For now, we're going to really stop the content and feature development of this game and close our chapter here. Let's meet again next time in different games.

Have a good day!
Cheers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/2ab232f2fecb1d5648e005b8aa86c4d21cb76f26.png[/img]

In addition, we are excited to announce that Aquaculture Land will be participating in the Winter Steam Sale, with a 20% discount on the game. We hope this sale provides an opportunity for new players to experience the game, and for current players to share it with their friends.

You can buy Aquaculture Land here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land_Fish_Farming_Simulation/

Notes:
1. In version 1.0, the save files from the Early Access phase will no longer be compatible and you will need to start a new game. 
2. In version 1.0, languages other than English are not fully available. We will provide further updates when it becomes available.

notes.title: Update Regarding Development State
notes.content:
Hello guys.
Long time no see.

Today we have something to tell you about Aquaculture Land. Because of several issues in the development department, we are very sorry we need to halt Aquaculture Land development since this month. It was a hard decision for us to do it. But we must do it for the good of the game itself. 

Our team needs to regularly switch tasks between Aquaculture Land and another project in the few past months. That's why the development becomes very slow. So we decided to halt the development temporarily until the team can fully focus on Aquaculture Land.

We will continue the development again when this issue is finished. We can't give you the exact time plan when we will be back, but it will be much longer than we think because our team is needed in a different department for now.

We already completed the design of the story for the campaign mode. But because of the issues, we need to postpone the update because the team still needs time to implement it in the game. Don't worry, we won't abandon Aquaculture Land. 

We have so much great feedback from you guys that need to be done and another roadmap design from us that still half developed. There are few more game design updates that we want to discuss with you guys. We will be back to Aquaculture Land for sure!

We sincerely apologize to all of you guys, to the community because we need to halt Aquaculture Land development. We hope that all of you guys will understand our decision and still support us, still giving us your feedback and suggestions for Aquaculture Land.

We will give update about the story in the next news, so you can see where the development for now.

Thank you so much for all your support so far guys. Thank you for all your feedback and suggestions, your reviews, and of course thank you so much for buying and playing Aquaculture Land. We hope we can see you guys again soon!

notes.title: Devlog 17 - New Type of Order Request and Market Demand Request
notes.content:
Hi.
How are you today?

It's been a long time since our last update about Aquaculture Land. We apologize for not providing any updates so far. We are currently working on the system and design that we will apply to Aquaculture Land. And also one thing or another that keeps us from giving news at all. 

Today we still talking about Customer Request. In the last devlog, we already talked about 2 of them (which already implemented in Career Mode and Free Mode), Urgent Order Request and Market Demand Request, so today we will talk about other types of Customer Request that we will implement to the game. Let's go!!!

Like we mentioned before, Customer Request is a type of request that involves customers such as customer orders, market demand, and visitors (fishing). There are 2 types of requests related to customer order, 2 types of requests related to market demand, and 3 types of requests related to visitors.

In accordance with the title of today's devlog, this time we will talk about Customer Request that is related to order and market demand. We will talk about Customer Request that is related to visitors later.

[h2][b]Customer Request: Contract Order Request[/b][/h2]
Contract Order Request has more or less the same objectives as Urgent Order Request, which is to deliver a number of fish in accordance with requests from the customer. The difference is Contract Order Request requires you to deliver a number of fish to the customer for a certain period of time.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/f54e0fc19c1a7d6ac4ae2535b300a842fa2dbaa1.gif[/img]


For example, in Contract Order Request that you take, you are required to deliver [number] of fish for [number] weeks. Then every week you have to deliver [number] of fish to the customer. After 3 weeks are finished, you will get a reward for completing the request.

[h2][b]Customer Request: Control Demand Request[/b][/h2]
If the Market Demand Request requires you to make the market demand of a type of fish reaches a certain number (according to the target demand in the request), then the Control Demand Request requires you to make the demand of a fish reach a certain point at the specified time.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/jbUdF3L.gif[/img]


At a glance, the Control Demand Request might look similar to the Market Demand Request, you are required to make the market demand reach a certain point in accordance with the target demand of the request. But what makes them different is if you take the Control Demand Request, market demand will rise every day (If you take Market Demand Request, market demand will remain the same until the request is complete). 

In Control Demand you are also required to make market demand reach the target demand at the end of the specified time. So if you reach the target demand before the specified time, the request will not be completed immediately. You need to control it until the time comes. That's why we called it "Control Demand" Request.

These 2 types of customer requests are still in the works. We also working on the remaining 3 types of customer requests related to visitors. We prepare it for the full release of Aquaculture Land.

We also want to say thank you very much for the positive feedback you have given for Career Mode and also for this new design. As well as the suggestions you provided, we really appreciate it. That really helps us to make Aquaculture Land better.

So, if you have any feedback or suggestions about today’s devlog or even anything about Aquaculture Land, feel free to tell us.

We will end today’s devlog here. Thank you so much for your support so far.

Join our Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/Fkk2wsC

Follow our Twitter: https://twitter.com/MaulidanGames


https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land/

See you in next devlog.
Cheers!

notes.title: Aquaculture Land Recap - v0.8.2
notes.content:
Hello.
Happy new year!!!

First of all, we really want to say thank you very much to all of you that buy our game, play our game, give us your feedback or suggestion about the game, give us your reviews, and for all of your support so far. We really appreciate it.

Thanks to all your feedback and suggestions, we can make Aquaculture Land better.

At this time, Aquaculture Land has reached version v0.8.2. Lots of changes have occurred when compared to the initial version. Especially in terms of appearance and of course the existing features.

So without further ado, this is the current version of Aquaculture Land!

[h1]New Languages[/h1]

In the current version, we already support 7 languages ​​that you can choose from. Last time, we just added 3 new languages ​​namely Russian, Spanish and German to Aquaculture Land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/c257158aedc63130ca8a2c4268a64ec66f3cf608.gif[/img]

[h1]Town Map[/h1]

A Town map is a place where you can meet your customers. You can also see what requests are available for each customer. You can choose what requests you want to take through this town map. There will be 2 types of customer requests, main requests, and repeatable requests.

When you want to take customer requests, you just need to click on the customer icon and then choose the request. We use the building icon as a representation of the customer because each customer will come from various backgrounds. Chef, middleman, pharmacist, fish collector, and others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/cafaba754ff7473fa97044f58a02ab9b6752bff4.gif[/img]

[h1]Customer Request[/h1]
Customer Request is a type of request related to the main features that are involving customers such as customer orders, market, and visitors (fishing). There are 7 types of Customer Requests we design for the game. But, we only implement 2 of them in the short version of Career Mode. And that 2 types of Customer Requests are Urgent Order and Market Demand.

[h2]Customer Request: Urgent Order Request[/h2]

Urgent Order Request is a type of customer request in which a customer will request an amount of fish from you. If you have played Aquaculture Land before, you will be familiar with this type of request. You just need to pay attention to the weight required and the minimum average quality of the fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/99658aeb8f83303775e98aaa99d03c5cfe2ec140.gif[/img]

[h2]Customer Request: Market Demand Request[/h2]

Market Demand Request is one of the new types of customer requests. This request is a customer request which is related to the market. In the previous version, we already implemented a feature called market demand where if you are selling one kind of fish to the market too often, their market demand will decrease, and that will affect their market price (the lower the market demand is, the lower the market price becomes).

Market Demand Request needs you to decrease the demand for the fish to a certain point, according to the target demand of the request.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/7c57eaeb156e58a0d560ba17f4826c4ee16b9445.gif[/img]

[h1]Journal Map[/h1]

Journal Map is a place if you want to see how's your progress so far. Journal Map is also a place where you can unlock something new, whether it unlocks new features, commodity licenses, or equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/23fb2c158fb9aba0f54c091d7c0e30dd11ed5cd9.gif[/img]

We also have a new way to unlock something. Everything about unlocking things will be related to the level of your Customer Relationship. You have to reach a certain level from a certain customer if you want to unlock something.

[h1]Breeding System[/h1]

Breeding is a feature to make your fish have a better status. With the breeding feature, you can increase your fish seeds' basic statuses such as growth, quality, and weight. Breeding is one of your solutions when you get a difficult order that needs a good quality or amount of fish within a certain period.

One thing to remember, only new fish seeds status that will change after the breeding process. If you have the same species of fish on your pond with your chosen fish for breeding, that fish's status won’t be affected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/24fe5bec44e102b0539c97fb86e927f26d8565d7.gif[/img]

[h1]Market Demand[/h1]

Market demand is a feature we create to make the game more balanced. It is an easy task to get a lot of money in the previous version. You just need to raise fish with the highest selling price then sell it to the market. But we don't want you to only focus on one fish. We want to make it more balanced so that each fish has the same chance for you to raise.

With the market demand feature, the more often a fish is sold to the market, the lower its selling price becomes. So, if you only focus on selling a type of fish to the market, the less money you get from selling that fish. We hope with this adjustment, the fish that will be used by you will be more varied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/2a28a3e090dc1631be9a6d3eef7a13cf038c8894.gif[/img]

[h1]Build Fishing Pond and Get Money From Your Visitor[/h1]

The Fishing pond is another way that you can use to earn money. But this time you won't get money from customer, but you will get it from visitor. When you have a fishing pond in you farm, visitors will come to you farm and fishing. Every time they get some fish, you will earn some money. But, don't forget to look at

The idea of the move item feature comes when you place an item in the wrong spot (aerator, generator, water filter), to put it back in the position you want, you have to sell the item first and then put the new one in the position you want. notes.title: Career Mode Come into The Main Branch! - Update version 0.8.1
notes.content:
Hi guys!
How are you today?

A few days ago, we created a thread in the discussion section about a teaser that we move Career Mode to the main branch after the positive feedback and suggestions we got from you in 'beta Career Mode' branch. Thank you very much for your support. We really appreciate it.

And today, we have a new update for Aquaculture Land! We have moved version 0.8.1 to the main branch to replace version 0.7.11!

So for those of you who haven't had the chance to try Career Mode version 0.8.1 in the 'beta Career Mode' branch before, now all you have to do is update your Aquaculture Land and you can immediately try playing Career Mode.

We still have a lot of homework that needs to be done based on your feedback and suggestion. After this update, besides we are working on our own update list, we will also be working on your feedback and suggestion list.

[h2]Career Mode[/h2]
If you have tried Career Mode in the 'beta Career Mode' branch, the Career Mode that we updated to this main branch (version 0.8.1) is more or less the same as the one in the 'beta Career Mode' branch.

In this version 0.8.1 in the main branch, we bring back Free Mode into the game. And in version 0.8.1, there are also some new things (especially the gameplay and features) that might look and feel different from version 0.7.11.

[h3]Customer Request[/h3]
In version 0.7.11, to get money, aside from selling fish to the market, you must complete an order from a customer. The customer will ask you to give them amount of fish according to the order and if you can complete the order according to the requirement and before the deadline runs out, you will get a reward.

[i]Order in version 0.7.11[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/1cf35c0991be29ef496cc255e2203f62503fbb04.gif[/img]


But in version 0.8.1, it becomes different. Customers are no longer just order number of fish, but they will give you a variety of requests, we called it “Customer Request”. There is a request that needs you to deliver an amount of fish to the customer, there is also a request asking you to sell your fish to the market.

Besides getting money for the rewards, by completing requests from customers, you will also get exp. point for Customer Relationship Level.

[i]Customer Request in version 0.8.1[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/a44d31923b8e7f356fbbe5e000708f26b92a9c28.gif[/img]


[h3]A New Way to Unlock[/h3]
Another thing that’s different in version 0.8.1 is a way to unlock something. In version 0.7.11, everything about unlocking is related to the farm level. When the farm level reaches a certain level then you can unlock something new.

notes.title: Devlog 14 - Fulfill Your Customer Needs Through Customer Request
notes.content:
Hello!

Back again with Aquaculture Land devlog. For your information, last week we just updated Career Mode to Aquaculture Land. It is still a short version of Career Mode, but there are new kinds of things you can try like a new way to take requests from your customers, new type of request, and more. You can see the details [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/858630/view/2229792025496704004]here[/url].

And today we will discuss the main features of the redesign that we do on the Career Mode, the customer request system. As we mentioned before, in this new design, all things will be more customer-centric. Your goal in playing Aquaculture Land is to build relationships with your customers. You will have a customer relationship level that shows how close you are to the customer. And to raise this level of customer relationship, you have to complete requests from customers.

[h2][b]Main Request and Repeatable Request[/b][/h2]
In this new design, requests from customers will be divided into 2, "Main Request" and "Repeatable Request". Main Request is a request related to the story of the game and you can only do it once, whereas Repeatable Request is a request that you can take repeatedly to raise your customer relationship level with existing customers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/c1a4f86eb06e80382df5e9fc32e79c9340379722.png[/img]


There are 2 types of Main Request, Unique Request and Customer Request. And for Repeatable Requests only the Customer Request. 

[h2][b]Unique Request[/b][/h2]
Unique Request is a request in the form of a scenario that you will only encounter for the purposes of the story. It's a little bit different from Customer Request type which directly involved with the customer, unique request more towards a thing that you need to do besides fulfilling the request from customers.  

[i]Unique Request: Reach Relationship Level 2 on Bernard.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/a16b5c96a162ac17d95ab9b97b6ed432394c92cc.gif[/img]


[h2][b]Customer Request[/b][/h2]
Customer Request is a type of request related to the main features that are involving customers such as customer orders, market, and visitors (fishing). Actually there are 7 types of Customer Requests we design for the game. But, we only implemented 2 of them in the short version of Career Mode. And that 2 types of Customer Requests are Urgent Order and Market Demand.

[h3][b]Customer Request: Urgent Order Request[/b][/h3]
Urgent Order Request is a type of customer request in which customer will request an amount of fish to you. If you have played Aquaculture Land before, you will be familiar with this type of request. You just need to pay attention to the weight required and the minimum average quality of the fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/76ddbc471946c82cdcca4466ec067ac4a7296125.gif[/img]


[h3][b]Customer Request: Market Demand Request [/b][/h3]
Market Demand Request is one of the new types of customer requests. This request is a customer request which is related to the market. Before, we already implemented a feature called market demand where if you are selling one kind of fish to the market too often, their market demand will decrease, and that will affect their market price (the lower the market demand is, the lower the market price becomes).

Market Demand Request needs you to decrease the demand of the fish to a certain point, according to the target demand of the request.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/213a02f74b3e9f5f77d9557f10decea02ff20592.gif[/img]


Later, the types of Customer Requests will be spread among existing customers. There will be some customers who have requests that are related to customer orders and some that are related to the market and visitors.

Every time you’ve completed the request, you will get a customer relationship exp. and some money for rewards. You can raise the customer relationship level for each customer this way. And when customer relationship level reaches a certain point, you can unlock some features or items. A little sneak peeks, you will get something special if you can reach level 10 (max level) of your customer relationship level.

There are 5 types of Customer Requests that we still working on. Another request related to order, another quest related to market demand, and other 3 types of customer requests related to the visitor. But, let's talk about it another time, okay?

So, this will be the end of today’s devlog. We hope this new main feature will make you more enjoy and feel more challenged when playing Aquaculture Land. And as we mentioned before, we already implemented these new features on Career Mode. So, if you want to know how are these new features, make sure you try the Career Mode.

And as always, if you have any suggestions or feedback about these new features or maybe about the game, feel free to tell us. That will really help us to make Aquaculture Land better so you can more enjoy to play it.

Join our Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/Fkk2wsC

Follow our Twitter: https://twitter.com/MaulidanGames


https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land/

Stay safe everyone. Have a good day.
Cheers!

notes.title: Development Recap of Aquaculture Land - Ver. 0.7.11(3)
notes.content:
Hello.
How are you today?

First of all, we really want to say thank you very much to all of you that buy our game, play our game, give us your feedback or suggestion about the game, give us your reviews, and for all of your support so far. We really appreciate it.

It has been almost a year since Aquaculture Land has been released to Steam Early Access. And during that time, Aquaculture Land continues to grow. Thanks to all your feedback and suggestions, we can make Aquaculture Land better.

At this time, Aquaculture Land has reached version 0.7.11 (3). Lots of changes have occurred when compared to the initial version. Especially in terms of appearance and of course the existing features.

So without further ado, this is the current version of Aquaculture Land!

[h2]Thematic Pixel Art UI[/h2]
The thematic pixel art UI is a new UI design we tried for Aquaculture Land. We decided to make this kind of design when we want to change the UI design at that time. We got feedback and suggestions about the design of the UI that a little not match with the theme of the game. At first, we just wanted to change the color but then our artist team had an idea to try pixel art design for the UI. We are going to change the design of the UI, so why not try something new? We also make a survey about the design and we’re very glad to know that you guys like this thematic pixel art design

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/d84539b2de3a54329c2167dd6c29bde8480ec11e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/acd8fd98f4af1739c8edddb64fd239c61ce27d21.png[/img]

[h2]Customer Bond Level[/h2]
Changes to the order system are our first step to redesign the core games and goals of Aquaculture Land. Later, your goal in playing Aquaculture Land is to build relationships with your customers. By completing the request that they give, your relationship level (we will call it "Customer Bond Level") will increase and as the Customer Bond Level increases, you can unlock something new (fish, items, features like breeding and fishing, etc. ).

So in addition to getting money as a reward after fulfilling customer orders and exp points for the farm level, you will also get exp points for raising customer bond levels. But for now, we haven't added an unlocking system via the customer bond level yet, the unlocking system still depends on the farm level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/580c57a82f80ed3b08e153fcd1e74384ca317b69.png[/img]

[h2]Worker for Helping You Manage Your Farm[/h2]
Worker will do the farm job for you. By default, worker will automatically do their job such as maintaining equipment, feeding fish, etc. But you can choose whether to make them stay self-initiative or player-directed in doing something.

You can also recruit more workers to make it easier for you to manage your garden. In total there are 10 workers that you can recruit with different points on each status.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/ee71da1b1c41dacb8e075b44089d770b9678c395.png[/img]

[h2]Deadline and Quality for Customer Orders[/h2]
For the current version, we add several criteria to the order feature, quality and deadlines. Quality is a minimum requirement for fish that you can send for order and deadlines are a time limit that you can use to fulfill the order. With these two things, you'll be challenged to fulfill orders with a good quality and lots of fish within a certain period!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/412de0f07703a35a7e4d4ee67c5b7aa6d2367ae5.png[/img]

[h2]Breeding System[/h2]
Breeding is a feature to make your fish have a better status. With the breeding feature, you can increase your fish seeds basic statuses such as growth, quality, and weight. Breeding is one of your solutions when you get a difficult order that needs a good quality or amount of fish within a certain period.

One thing to remember, only new fish seeds status that will change after the breeding process. If you have same species of fish on your pond with your chosen fish for breeding, that fish status won’t be affected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/68dd913795d515241bc1e18a48b6bafb1fe83688.gif[/img]

[h2]Build Fishing Pond and Get Money From Your Visitor[/h2]
Fishing pond is a feature that we make because  we got feedback that said it takes a long time to receive some money from selling fish. And when you wait for your fish to be big enough for you to sell, you have no income. This fishing pond will be your steady stream of income. So, while you wait for your money from selling fish, you will still get some income from visitors that fish on your fishing pond. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/ce4507029a5a9bcefa555bb65ae90e6b16067af2.gif[/img]

[h2]Market Demand[/h2]
Market demand is a feature we create to make the game more balanced. Before, if you want to get much money, it’s quite simple to do. You just need to raise fish with the highest selling price then sell it to the market. But we don't want you to only focus on one fish. We want to make it more balanced so that each fish has the same chance for you to raise.

With the market demand feature, the more often a fish is sold to the market, the lower its selling price becomes. So, if you only focus on selling 1 type of fish to the market, the less money you get from selling that fish. We hope with this adjustment, the fish that will be used by you will be more varied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/290cbfd56e6c4388ec444d6cfff7f0217d709cff.gif[/img]

We already made a thread about the Early Access State of Aquaculture Land in the discussion. At that thread, we will always update the current state of Aquaculture Land. We also include a list of planned features that we will later implement in the game as well as features that we have implemented in the current version. You can check the thread [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858630/discussions/0/2263565217508531370/]here[/url].

Right now we still work on new features for our next update. Just a little sneak peek, our new update will be a demo version of Campaign Mode. We’re so excited! We can't wait to show it to you! We hope everything goes well so we can show it to you soon.

This will be the end of this development recap. If you still put Aquaculture Land in your wishlist, make sure you buy and try Aquaculture Land now before our next update. 

If you guys have any feedback or suggestions about Aquaculture Land, feel free to tell us. That will really help us. We always want to know what you think about Aquaculture Land, what do you feel about it. So, we can make it more enjoyable for you when you play the game.

Join our Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/Fkk2wsC
Follow our Twitter: https://twitter.com/MaulidanGames

Have a good day.
Cheers!

[h3]New Order System[/h3]

For the current version, we add several criteria to the order feature, quality and deadlines. There is also bond levels for customers. notes.title: Devlog 11 - We redesign the order feature! New customer incoming!
notes.content:
Hello.

It’s been a long time since we posted the last devlog. These past few months we’re focused on implementing visual feedback and new UI design to the game (and fixing bugs and balancing too). Along with it, we also redesign the order feature. In this new design, we want you to make a relationship with the customer so you will become their trusted aquaculture businessman.

So, without further ado, here's today's devlog for you!

[h3]CUSTOMER[/h3]
There will be 11 customers (in total) for the new order feature. Each customer will give you a different order based on their job and personality. Yes, customers will have their own job and personality. What kind of fish they will order and other criteria like deadline, quality, and weight will be based on their job and personality. There will be customers from supermarkets, restaurants, food vloggers, and many others.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/7c10970d032295dc754dfb38654801d00bba801a.png[/img]

But if you want to get orders from different customers, you need to unlock them first. You need to reach a certain farm level (player level before, now we called it “Farm Level”) along with fame level and loyalty level to unlock them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/da2ce6ae8d58d8bc99fbdd59377842795a241913.png[/img]

Customers will have loyalty level. To make a good relationship with them, you need to make sure that their orders are fulfilled properly. You will get a loyalty exp point every time you fulfill their orders properly. With this loyalty exp point, you can increase your loyalty level. The higher loyalty level you reach, the greater the reward you get from the order.

[h3]ORDER[/h3]
The new order will have few more criteria than the old one to complete it. Deadline, quality, fame point, and loyalty point will be added to order. If in the current version, the focus is only on weight of the fish, in the new design you need to pay attention to the deadline and quality of the fish too. Because if you can’t deliver the order within the deadline, your order will be failed and deleted. And if your fish quality is lower than your customer needs, you can’t deliver it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/d16b86381dc4134ca1d3dfd2b8f74f36dfdb01cb.png[/img]

Beside that, order will not only give you money and farm level exp and loyalty point, but also a fame point. You need to collect fame points to level up your fame level. You will see this fame level as a bar that contains fame points. This fame level will affect your order and visitor. The higher the fame level, the faster orders and visitors come. So, if you want to get order quicker, you need to make sure you’re maintaining the fame level in a good state. There will be certain conditions that can make your fame points decrease. And the worst thing if you get your fame points very low, you will find it difficult to get orders.

We have prepared everything we need for this new design of order feature. We are currently balancing all things relating to it. We hope that everything will run smoothly so that we can show this update to you soon.

If you have any suggestions or feecback about today's devlog, feel free to tell us. Your feedback and suggestion will really help us with the development and help us to make the game better.

Until next time, have a good day.

notes.title: Update 0.7.10(1) - Visual Feedback for Your Pond & Custom Game
notes.content:
Hello guys
How’s your day?

Today we have some updates for Aquaculture Land. For a few past weeks, we updated custom mode into experimental build because we still need to adjust a few things. And today, we decided to move custom mode to the main build along with the visual feedback update.

[h1]Custom Mode[/h1]
There isn't much change from the custom mode that we update to the main build. Custom mode is an additional feature for Free Mode. The custom mode feature is created because we want to retain the essence of Free Mode, where players are free to play as they wish, with a progression process, where all features such as fish and equipment are locked so that players can unlock these features one by one and feel the progression.

With this feature, you can choose your starting conditions to play in Free Mode (like Sandbox Mode in general). There are several conditions that you can choose such as starting level, starting money, fish, and equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/4eac993c7b31cddd6a8f13bdb819d26a7080fd4e.gif[/img]

[h1]Visual Feedback[/h1]
Visual feedback is one of the things that is lacking in Aquaculture Land. We realized it after watching some players playing Aquaculture Land. We also got some feedback that said they don’t know what is happening with their farm. So, we decided to add this visual feedback to help players understand what is happening with their farm, especially with their fish.

[b]Pond Sign[/b]
Every pond you build has several statuses. You need to make sure that the statuses meet the commodities needs. Your commodities will be in bad condition if you don’t meet those needs.

For the current version, everything that happened with the status will be shown with the bubble icon (that represented the status that changed). So, if in the previous version there was only a warning icon that appears after the status going bad, right now every time the pond status increase or decreases, you’ll be shown with a bubble status icon.

We also changed the pond warning icon with the new one, because we thought the old one is not clear enough to tell you what the icon means.

[b]Work Sign[/b]
Work sign is a sign that will appear every time your worker will do something. Dig pond, fill water, cut bush, repairing equipment, etc. We changed the worker sign because we want to make this sign clear enough to understand. And we also give a little animation to the sign so it will become juicier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/174513d1e66d6ac0bfb950a4982d83e56b0d69ef.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog 07 - Translation & System Balancing (Breeding & Fish)
notes.content:
Hello.

In today's devlog we are still talking about balancing. In the previous devlog we discussed the system upkeep in ponds and equipment, this time balancing for fish and breeding. There is a discussion about translation too.

[h1]Unlock Fish[/h1]
We made a slight change to the flow to unlock new fish. We try to balance the system by add cost if you want to unlock new fish. Besides having to reach a certain level, you need to buy a license for the fish to be unlocked. The player also needs to pay a sum of money each month for each fish license he buys. It's like a tax for the fish license.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/354158bb9e5868d7c0c83e6cdef24373fafb4a94.gif[/img]

[h1]Breeding Cost[/h1]
For the current version, you can use the breeding feature when you reach level 7. You will earn breeding points when the fish reach level 3. With these breeding points, you can use the breeding feature and make your basic fish status increase.

We changed the concept slightly by adding costs to breeding. So besides using breeding points, you need to pay some money to use breeding feature. As with breeding points, the amount of money that needs to be paid will increase each time you breed the same fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/aadea23796ae191ee6bc29f016e90f5ff22ce0d4.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog 06 - System Upkeep (Pond & Equipment)
notes.content:
Hello.

Today's devlog will talk about the upkeep system, one of the ways that we use to balance the Aquaculture Land system. We are still trying to make the system more balanced so that it is more enjoyable to play. This time, the upkeep system that we tried to implement in the game is upkeep in ponds and equipment.

[h1]Pond Upkeep[/h1]
In the current version, weekly expenses that charged to the player are only from the worker's salary. To balance income and expenses, we try to add upkeep to the pond in the form of maintenance money for the pond. Calculation of upkeep that needs to be paid from one pond based on the size of the pond. So, the bigger or more ponds you owned, the more expenses will be spent by the player for the upkeep system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/211cbc22d3b1545e456815d36ed13d5a451bef5e.gif[/img]

[h1]Equipments Upkeep[/h1]
For pond equipment, we balance the price and status of each equipment. We do this to make each equipment different from one another, not only in terms of price but also in terms of usage. Just like ponds, we also add upkeep to equipment. Upkeep that needs to be paid for equipment based on how expensive the equipment you have. So the more expensive equipment you have, the more upkeep you will need to pay. But the more expensive the price of equipment, the better the status of the equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/b7cbdfd37209f8bbbc54cba4c905475c5db2fc2e.gif[/img]

We will continue to balance the system for the next few weeks. We will try to ensure that the next version is balanced enough before updating the game. We hope after we update the game with a more balanced system, it will make you enjoy playing Aquaculture Land.

So, that's it for today's devlog. If you have suggestions or feedback, feel free to tell us in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858630/discussions/][b]discussion[/b][/url] or in the comment section below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land/

Have a great weekend.
Cheers!

notes.title: Devlog 05 - Order Demand & Market Demand
notes.content:
Hi,
How is your day?

This week is still about balancing for the Aquaculture Land system. As we said in the last devlog, besides we're focused on redesigning the core gameplay, we will also focus on balancing in several things. One of them is the economic system that exists in the Aquaculture Land.

We talked about market demand last week, today we will discuss it again and we will talk about order demand, balancing on customer orders.

[h1]Order Demand[/h1]
Customer orders feature is one way that you can use to get money in Aquaculture Land. When we later add market demand to the game, we think that players who did grinding by selling fish to the market will turn to customer orders. Therefore we need to do balancing for customer orders.

We will do balancing on how often customer orders will come and the distribution of ordered fish will also be more adjusted to the state of the player at that time. The weight of the fish that needs to be met, the time for order completion, the quality of the fish, and the things that affect the order will be balanced.

For now, customer orders are impressed as a feature that is used only to level up. Without punishment when a player fails to fulfill an order, players can take any order or reject it without hesitation. Therefore, another thing we will do for balancing is to add deadlines to each order. If the player cannot complete the order on time, that will affect the next orders.

We will also plan to categorize and make customers, who will send orders, have a characteristic. We get this idea from @convey who told us in the discussion forum. One example is a customer who works at a luxury restaurant will give orders in the form of high quality with a small amount of fish but has a very short time for completion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/0d413348aaed429cc56745e8b7ba20c1b993e81b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/77f394e30b629a5ca863c0d259513d08e80ed83b.png[/img]

We hope with giving balancing to the orders, the game will be more challenged for the players  

[h1]Market Demand[/h1]
Market demand is one of balancing methods that we will apply to the market to reduce player that continuously sells only one type of fish to the market to easily obtain large amounts of profit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/a001f8e1e6ced93c972f578739c60eaf40f4eae0.png[/img]

If the player too often sells the fish to the market, then the price of the fish will gradually decrease and will not benefit the player. You can check market demand condition in the market menu. If the graph is red, that means the fish price is decreasing. The fish price will increase if you do not sell the fish to the market within a certain time.

With this market demand, we want to make players do not only focus on getting profits through one type of fish but a variety of it depending on the market demand.

We also do balancing on the market price to make players feel more challenged and come up with more varied strategies to keep their farm running and keep getting the best profit.


We are aware that it will take a little while for everything to become balance. Therefore, in the future, there is a possibility that we will continue to make adjustments for things that we feel are not balance. We will try to make this game more challenging to play.

So if you feel that for the current version there are still things that have not been balanced, you can tell us. And also if there is feedback or suggestions about the game, feel free to tell us in the comments section below or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858630/discussions/][b]discussion[/b][/url].

Okay, that’s it for today’s devlog. There are still a lot of things we need to do for the game but we will do our best to make the game better.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land/

Have a good day.
Cheers!

Hi guys
Long time no see. How are you?

This past few weeks we're focused on fixing bug and optimized the experimental build. We try to make the experimental build become more stable. And finally, in this new update, the current build is stable enough. We move the current build into the main build so you guys can try it out. You can try all features from the experimental build in this latest update and of course more optimized and stable. Besides the features, we give another touch to the current build. What is that another touch? Let's check today's update out!

[h1]Fishing Pond[/h1]
We got feedback that said it takes a long time to earn some money from selling fish because you need to wait for a while until your fish is big enough to be sold. While you're waiting, you won't get any income. That's why we make this fishing pond feature so while you waiting for your money from selling fish, you will still get some income from your fishing pond. Thing to remember, only level 2 fish (and above) which can be catch by visitor.

In experimental build version, visitor arrival will make the game laggy. For this update, we already did some optimized so you won't be bother by lag anymore.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/1aac84beccbc3c936b864212c4b4a725a1044036.gif[/img]

[h1]Breeding[/h1]
Breeding feature is a feature that you can use to increase your fish basic status. With this feature you can increase growth speed, fish weight, and fish quality. You can make a superior fish with breeding feature.

Only your fish seed status will be increased after breeding process. If you have the same fish in your pond with your breeding fish, your fish status in your pond will not increase.

Thank you so much to @Arburtus, @Rayune, and @Sardine for giving us an idea to make this feature.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/bb50cea689a7e0fe335008f1e0e59db696683b78.gif[/img]

This feature will help you reach level 2 fish faster and heavier than the previous generation. So you can harvest your fish earlier with heavier fish. But for using this feature, you need resource called breeding points. You can get this breeding point from nurturing your fish. Every time your fish grows, you will get breeding points.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/a57b867bd4a225d2675e1356d879ff4da427f484.gif[/img]

For previous version, you can get breeding points from level 1 fish. But on this update, we did some balance and make only level 3 fish (and above) that produce breeding points. So whether you sell your biggest fish or use it to produce some amount of breed points, you choose it ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Storage[/h1]
In the previous version, every time you harvest your fish, your fish box will be lying on your farm. Sometimes your fish box will block your worker path and look like a mess. Thank you to @Amnaa and @lucatolo that come with storage feature suggestion. With this storage feature, your fish box will be automatically stored into storage so make it more organized and make your farm look neater.

The other good thing from storage feature is when you want to make your fish bigger (fish that already stored) or if you want to move your fish into another pond, you can put back your fish box into your pond.

We also add a fish box counter on storage. So, with this counter, you will know how many fish boxes you have in storage without always open the storage to check it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/a67bbb89e074a1a8098a1230e1f557082adc44f4.gif[/img]

[h1]French Language[/h1]
For current version, we add new French language. Thank you so much for @CdriX for helping us with French translation this far. You can only change the game language from setting on main menu.

There will be some texts that have a smaller size than the others because when the text is translated from English to French, it becomes longer. In this new update, we use a different font with experimental build version. With this new font, the smaller text will be better and more legible than experimental build version.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/0e0fea66153cef8b86397dc69bdad8f446bcc3d7.gif[/img]

If you want to add your own language into the game, you can check [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858630/discussions/2/1640919103676483577/][b]Community Translation Thread[/b][/url] in the discussion section for the details. We can’t do it alone. Let’s do some collaboration!

[h1]Game Tutorial[/h1]
We finally add basic tutorial to the game. With this tutorial, we want to give a clue to our players what they need to do and pay attention to. Because we saw some people don't have any clue what to do. Especially for fish status and how to manage it. The tutorial will be the basic action you need to do for one loop gameplay, from building ponds to selling fish.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/90c6b3230234d2b614fa446063133abe8082d307.gif[/img]

[h1]Resource Bubble, Electric Item Sign, and Electric Connection Toggle UI[/h1]
We add little touch to toggle pond and fish info UI. We add resource bubble, electric item sign, and electric connection toggle.

Basically this toggle UI will be used to make the object visible or invisible. Resource bubble is for every resource that has bubble appearance (like  breeding points), electric item sign will cover every sign on electric item (like on off sign), and electric connection is for connection between electricity source and other items.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/7e2fbdc5ffd115b84ef4e9f155f9fcc0143e9e5b.gif[/img]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
We changed some terms that we use for fish status. We change pond density into living space, noise into acoustic comfort, fish waste into fish waste free and etc. We're doing that to make better meaning for the pond status with the status bar.

We also do the balancing on the status of pond equipment and its prices. We do that balancing so that one equipment and another will become more useful and can be used evenly. We also do some balancing on fish status, especially on their acoustic comfort. In the previous version, some of the fish statuses are too difficult to handle. For this reason, we adjust it again so the fish that raised by the player can be more diverse and the level of difficulty perceived by the player is better. 

For worker, we changed their status. We decided to delete the tenacity status. We also doing some adjustment to their status points because in the previous version, their status points are not balances enough. So, in this current version, more good your worker status, more expensive his hire price and salary.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Finally, after a few weeks, we can update the game from experimental build into version 0.7.8. We hope with this new version, our players that haven't had time to try experimental build, they can try the new feature in this version. 

Just like our plan, after this update, we will be more focus on redesign Aquaculture Land core design. From all of feedback and suggestion we received, we feel like there is something wrong with the core design. And we need to do something about it. Therefore, after this we will rarely make significant updates. But don't worry, we will still make a list for your suggestions and feedback. Maybe we will find an idea about the redesign from your feedback and suggestions. We will also still update about the bugfix. For the details about our next move, you can check this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858630/discussions/0/1640919103676489645/][b]thread[/b][/url]

We also give you the changelog from today's update down below so you will know more about the update details. If you have feedback and suggestions about today’s update, feel free to tell us in the comment section below or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858630/discussions/][b]discussion[/b][/url].

We want to say many thanks to all of you guys that already played our game, give us your honest review about the game, many suggestions and feedback, and other things that help us to make Aquaculture Land become a better game. Thank you for all of your support. And we hope you will still support us from now on.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land/

See you next time guys.
Cheers!

We don't want to break our main build that we think right now is stable enough to play. We also wanted to validate our design for this new feature so we hope we hear feedback from you.

In this experimental build, we already added some new updates that we already mentioned in our last devlog. And of course, if you found problem just tell us.

You still can load your save file from previous version, so you don’t need to play it from the beginning. But, after you play with your previous save file, you must save it in the new slot, because there is also a chance that save file from this build will encounter problem. It is also to make sure your old save file can be played again in the main build.

**Before continue we wanted to remind you again this build is still not stable enough, so play it with that in mind. We planned to make sure next week this build will stable. So we need your help if you found any game breaking bug or other problem.**

If you want to try this experimental build, you just need to do these steps:
[list]
[*] Right-click on Aquaculture Land in your Steam client and click properties.
[*] Click Betas tab.
[*] In “Select the beta” dropdown menu, choose experimental build.
[*] Click close and you’re ready to play Aquaculture Land experimental build
[/list]
To make sure you already on experimental build, just look at Aquaculture Land title in your steam client. If the title said Aquaculture Land [experimental-build], you already on experimental build and you can play it.

We did some updates on fishing pond feature. We try a new way to change normal pond into fishing pond. We also add visitor info that will appear if you click the visitor. With this visitor info, you will know what your visitor favorite fish to catch.

You have a limited amount to change from normal pond into fishing pond. This amount is based on how many fishing pond license you have. You will get 1 additional license each time your level increases by 5.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/9b56a1152f906c58b9527ac4400f51f396d58151.gif[/img]

Every time your visitor catch fish, you will get money immediately. So, while you are waiting for your normal pond to produce some fish to be sold, you will get some amount of money from your fishing pond. Thing to remember, only level 2 fish can be caught. So, make sure you have level 2 or above in your fishing pond or you will get nothing from your visitor.

[h1]Breeding[/h1]
Breeding feature will be available from the beginning of the game. But, to use breeding feature, you need breed points. You can get breed points by nurturing your fish. The bigger your fish, the more breed points you can get. So whether you sell your biggest fish or use it to produce some amount of breed points, you choose it ːsteamhappyː

With breeding feature, you can increase your fish seed basic status. We use percentages for the addition of each basic status so it will be different for each fish, depends on their basic status. We designed this breeding feature to make it easy to use.

[h1]Storage[/h1]
Storage feature comes to make your fish box (yields) become more organized. It also makes your farm cleaner because every time you store you fish, your fish box will automatically stored into storage.

Thing that good from storage is if you feel like you still want to make your fish (that already stored) bigger or maybe if you want to move your fish into another pond, you can put back your fish box from storage into your pond.

notes.title: Early Access Devlog 03 - Breeding Process & Storage
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/caf94148b204269949197ff21f1f9b4c9b5339e7.gif[/img]

Hello,
How are you?

We already talked about fishing pond and its new look in the last devlog, and today it’s time to talk about the other feature for our next big update, breeding feature. We called it [b]hatchery feature[/b] in the last devlog but from now on we called it [b]breeding feature[/b].

Besides breeding, we will also show you a new feature called storage. Why do we add storage to the game? Let’s check today’s devlog for the details!

[h1]Breeding[/h1]
Breeding is a feature to make your fish have a better status. With the breeding feature, you can increase your fish seeds basic statuses such as growth, quality, and weight. You can make a superior fish product with this feature.

Using breeding feature is quite simple, but still need to be careful. You need to choose which fish you want to breed. And then select 2 fish as parents that have addition of the status that you want. After the breeding process finished, the fish seeds status of your chosen fish will change. You can save the new status as parent status that you can use for next breeding. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/9b228274cde381867c54123a1b4bae9583c86072.gif[/img]

Only new fish seeds status that will change after the breeding process. If you have same species fish on your pond with your chosen fish for breeding, that fish status won’t be affected.

With this feature, you can do some experiment with fish seed basic status. Which basic status you need to increase to get the best fish and yields.

[h1]Storage[/h1]
Storage will be a place for your fish box (your yields). In the current version (0.7.7 version), every time you harvest your fish, your fish box will be placed beside the pond. If you already have many ponds, that will look messy and unorganized. And it will block your worker path too.

With the storage, your fish box will be more organized and your farm will look cleaner. So, after this, every time you harvest your fish, your fish box will be automatically stored to storage. From storage, you can drag your fish box to your customer order or direct selling it to the market. You can also put back your fish from your fish box to the pond.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/824e70498f4ebc072714bb56313bab328a2dbc7e.gif[/img]

We still do some adjustments to fishing pond feature and breeding feature. We planned to release these two features on experimental build first instead of release it on the main build. We split the build for this new feature because we have many changes in the feature and we don't want to break the stable build in version 0.7.7. After we make sure the new version is stable enough we will move the experimental build to the default build.

For you who want to try the experimental build, we will make a tutorial on how you will get those build when it is ready.

Before we ended today's devlog, we want to say thank you to @Arburtus, @Rayune, and @Sardine for giving us an idea to make this breeding feature. Thank you to @Amnaa for storage feature suggestion. We want to say thank you to all of you guys who play our game, who give us feedback and suggestion so far, you guys are really helping us to make the game better. We always make a note of your suggestion and feedback. From that note, we pick and create a list of our next feature for the game. Please keep supporting us from now on. Let's make Aquaculture Land better together.
 
That’s it for our talk about the breeding process and storage feature. We want to say sorry because it takes quite a time for us to finished these two features. There are still some things we need to do with these features. We'll do our best to make you enjoy playing Aquaculture Land with these new features.

As always, if you guys have some suggestions or feedback about today’s devlog or about the current version of the game, feel free to tell us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858630/discussions/]discussion[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land/

Have a nice day guys.
Cheers!

notes.content:

Hello guys.
How are you today?

Today we still talk about fishing pond. This past week, our artist team make a new design for fishing pond. So, there will be a different look between your normal pond and your fishing pond. We also add a feature to moving out your fish from one pond into another. And some water plant design to show you. Without further ado, let’s check it out!

[h1]Fishing Pond[/h1]
So, actually, our artist team make two designs for how fishing pond will look like. Then we decided to use this design. We chose this design because it’s suite better than the other one. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/280d9b853c446a053674d81950df1db908a1df04.png[/img]

We decided to make this kind of look because we want to make fishing pond and normal pond looks different. So, you can easily distinguish between fishing pond and normal pond. At first, to distinguish between fishing pond and normal pond, we only used a piece of board with fishing sign on it for fishing pond. But, we thought that fishing board (or sign) is not enough to show or to distinguish between fishing pond and normal pond. That's why we tried to change the appearance of the fishing pond.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/46eaa421d53fb657ba9168e4c35ec8c2a237e12a.gif[/img]

We are still looking for a good and smooth way to show the process when you change from normal pond into fishing pond (it won’t be that instant).

[h1]Moving Fish[/h1]
After we have planned a fishing pond feature, we thought that it will be bad if every time you run out of fish on your fishing pond, you must change your fishing pond into normal pond to nurturing some fish. After your fish big enough, you change your normal pond into fishing pond again. That will take too much step for you, right? Or you could change your other normal pond into fishing pond while you're nurturing some fish, but that's kinda troublesome. That's why we come with this feature, moving out your fish. With this feature, you can easily fill your empty fishing pond with new fish from your normal pond. 

With this kind of feature, you're not only can move your fish from normal pond to fishing pond but also you can move your fish into any pond you have. You can come with strategy to save your fish from a bad pond with move it to a better pond.

[h1]Water Plant[/h1]
Actually, water plant is an old feature that already done but we decided not to show or use it when we released Aquaculture Land on Steam Early Access in early phase. Water plants will be alternative pond equipment you can use for producing dissolved oxygen for your pond. It won’t produce any noise and cheaper than aerators. It can be used for decoration too and make your pond look beautiful. But, thing to remember, it will increase your pond parasite. We already make several designs for water plant and each of it will have different statuses, just like other pond equipment.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/c39a787c371900934c5afb1e9524d6aa45e9b254.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/27e665454553422072cd08212bb4d545bec471e7.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access Devlog 01 - Fishing Pond and Hatchery
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MuBJmUF.gif[/img]

Hello guys.
How’s your day?

These past two weeks are some intense yet exciting weeks for us. Because we're not only working for one new feature, but we are working on two new features for our next big update. So, what are those two features? Let’s check it out!

[h1]Fishing Pond[/h1]
One of the new features that we are working these past two weeks is fishing pond. We already gave you a teaser about it in the past update. And today, we’ll talk about the details. Let’s go!

The main purpose of this feature is because we got feedback that said it takes a long time to receive some money, which is when you succeed in selling your fish. But, as long as you wait for your fish to get big enough to be sold, you got no income. The problem is you still need to pay some routine expenses even when you don’t get any income. We make this feature to solve that problem. This fishing pond will be your steady stream of income. So, while you waiting for your money from selling fish, you will still get some income from your fishing pond.

Then, how you make this fishing pond? The fishing pond comes from your fish pond. Basically you just need a pond (old one or make a new one) then just register it to become a fishing pond and voila you get your fishing pond. And if you register the fishing pond from an empty pond, you can transfer fish from your other pond to the fishing pond. Things to note, fish that can be transferred into fishing pond only level 2 fish. 

After you have a fishing pond, customer will come and he will be fishing in the pond with the fish he wants. Every fish that customer catch will give you some money. You can also do promotions to attract customers. Or you can make your fishing pond more attractiveness so customers will come to your place (we still figure it out how to increase attractiveness, whether using decoration or something. Maybe you guys have suggestions about this? :D ).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lIcrXZX.gif[/img] 

[h1]Hatchery[/h1]
The second feature is hatchery. This feature comes when we want to give “Quality” to fish status. This feature is used for increasing the basic status of fishes. So, to make a superior fish product, you can use this feature. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/y2s3LCs.gif[/img]

In the game, you will use service from your colleague that works on the hatchery industry to breed your fish. You just need to choose which fish you want to breed and what kind of status you want to increase. Basic weight, growth rate, resistance status from something bad, and others, those are kind of basic status you can increase. 

Every process of hatchery will need breed points. You can get this breed point from nurturing your fish. Every time your fish grows, you will get breed points. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0CTRUfw.gif[/img]

Things to remember, after your hatchery process is done, only the fish seeds basic status will increase. If you have same fish on your pond, that fish status won’t increase.

We hope these two features will make the game more exciting and more enjoyable to play. And of course more fun too. We already make a list of feedback and suggestions for feature we’ll add to the game. And we choose to work on these two features first. We’ll do our best and hope we can finish these features soon so you guys can try it. There will also chance that you guys need to play the game from the start (new game) if we already add these new features. Because these new features will change some components from the game and that will affect your save file.


Okay, that's it for today's devlog. What do you guys think about the new features? Or maybe you have suggestions for those new features, as always feel free to tell us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858630/discussions/]discussion[/url].

Have a nice day, guys.

In this update, we made a few minor changes to the UI and gameplay behavior. One example of changes to the UI is the addition of toggle views. Toggle view is used to show or hide indicators that exist in several things such as pond warning, fish feeling, fish info, and electricity.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/ce09307efc6b456468e3397177d934ec04190252.gif[/img]

Then there is also an additional feature for canceling actions from workers. We feel that this is also quite important for game flow. Because in the previous version if we did an action that would later be done by a worker, especially if the action is wrong one, then we would not be able to cancel the worker to do the action and that would be quite annoying.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/9dfd688eedbd51546b58618415026214fa1c62b9.gif[/img]

We also add animated condition info for fish in pond details showing the fish undergoing health restoration process or in decreasing process. With this indicator, we can know the state of our fish at that time and which fish are in good or bad condition. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/2b30fe9db2ecbe3334cf014ffdbd83f6ea023f11.gif[/img]

If you guys have problem after updating or wanted to give feedback or suggestions about this update or about anything else, as always feel free to tell us in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/858630/discussions/]discussion[/url].

notes.title: Pre-Early Access Devlog 02 [Building pond]
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/cb5205678a59f8b3d20f1ff48d6575352d8529d7.png[/img]

Hello :D
How’s your day?

We’re back again with Aquaculture Land pra-early access devlog. And today, we’ll talk about how to build your pond. Pond is one of the most important thing in the game. Because pond will be place for your fish or other commodities to live in. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/9f3aed10da41f2d4638f0d2f3661a0be6de473e1.gif[/img]

You can design your pond whatever you want. You can make a very large pond, a small one, or even you can make your own unique pond. It’s all yours. But remember to always check your money and space for pond equipments (We’ll skip the discussion about pond equipments in a different post :D ).

[h1]Building Pond[/h1]
So, if you want to build a pond, first you must click the shovel icon. Click on the empty field, then move your cursor to draw the shape of your pond. Click again to finish and your pond blueprint is ready to build. . You’ll be shown the price of the pond based on how large your pond will be. After that, your worker will do his job to finish the pond.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/70160a1f67df72c8219ef7d4d5ed9a956f710318.gif[/img]

After that, you need to fill the pond with water. To do that, click the water button, then there will be some types of water you can choose. Different type of water will have a different effect for the healthiness of the fishes. Choose one of them, then click it to your empty pond.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/afef409c20d1d39421788b781ad9ef84141c0ee9.gif[/img]

Finally, now you can put your fish there. There are other types of commodities other than fish too, like molluscs and crustaceans. Pick one of them and then click it to your water-filled pond. Please note that some commodities are sold in group, check them first so you don’t click too much. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/74509aafe1d6c7300bd575977469f086dca8c305.gif[/img]


[h1]Extending Pond[/h1]
The number of fish you put in a pond and the size of the pond itself will affect the pond density. Some types of commodities don’t really like a crowded pond, so sometimes you will need a larger pond. You can always build a new pond with a larger size, or you can extend your existing ponds too. Other than that, by extending your pond, you can say goodbye to your old boring square pond.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/7d8f201005968e2ba6396ebf6131536dbd21f381.gif[/img]

Okay, that’s it for our second pra-early access devlog. So, what do you guys think? Any suggestion or feedback about how to make your pond? Just leave it on comments section below or you can post on Steam community discussion.

Don't forget to wishlist so you will know the newest update about Aquaculture Land.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land/

See you on the next devlog and please keep supporting us :)
Cheers!

notes.title: Pre-Early Access Devlog 01 (Aquaculture Land)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/cb5205678a59f8b3d20f1ff48d6575352d8529d7.png[/img]


Hello  guys :)
Long time no see, how are you?
 
First of all, we’re really sorry that it’s been awhile from our last news. Start from today, we will post our pre-early access devlog for  Aquaculture Land, our development preparation news for early access state. Our hope is we can show you the current state of Aquaculture Land with this pre-early access devlog. So you guys will know how the game is before you can try it on early access. You can also give us suggestion or feedback in every pre-early access devlog post about the game.

Today we will talk about Aquaculture Land. So without further ado, here it is, Aquaculture Land :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/4fb2cbf4985d09d28c1e617663602cf0f6f51d2a.gif[/img]

Aquaculture Land is an aquafarming simulation game. In this game, you will act as a businessman that runs a freshwater fish farm. You will manage all things related to fisheries, grow your fish, produce some high-quality fish, and fulfill the needs of your customer to get benefits for your business.

In Aquaculture Land, you can build your own Aquaculture farm and learn how to manage it. You can design your pond whatever you want it to be and make it unique. There are alot of commodities you can cultivate. Not only fish, there are crustacean and molluscan too. You will learn about the business too. How you make benefits from aquaculture farm so you can keep your farm running.

For the current state, there are some features you can do :


[h1]Build Pond[/h1]
You can build your own pond. You can design it whatever you want. Make it unique.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/d429f6982f0fa41c382d24280ff70f67a74d8dbc.gif[/img]


[h1]Equipment for Pond[/h1]
You can equip your pond with kind of pump and generator to meet your fish needs. Make your fish stay alive.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/fecbc2e45f4262f38ccff26e4b7102f28d01f961.gif[/img]


[h1]Feeding Your Commodity[/h1]
You can feed your commodities. Feed them so they'll stay healthy.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/8611d0ce86e974932c4d11532b2f1d4e8e1a50b3.gif[/img]


[h1]Sell Your Commodity[/h1]
After your fish big enough or meet your customer need, you can sell it. You can also sell it to market. Make sure to always check the market graph to know which commodity has the biggest price.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/35bc83ff620fcc0333e87f1ec92cb7049e498a6a.gif[/img]


[h1]Hire Workers[/h1]
When your farm is going bigger, you'll need some help to manage it. You can hire some workers to do the farm job.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/4844610e56f3e7821a7d6c7188cacfc0b59e301a.gif[/img]

And others features that we still working on.

We still have problems with balancing some features. We rework it to find the best way to deliver it to you guys. There are some bugs that we need to fix too.There are couples of things we need to do for the game. We want to give you guys the best play experience even in the early access state. We'll do our best to make the things done. So while waiting for the game, we will post pre-early access devlog frequently to update the state of the game. Please, keep supporting us :)

That's it for today’s devlog. For the next devlog will be explanation about the features above one by one.

So what do you guys think with this current state? Please leave your suggestion or feedback in the comment section below or in the discussions.

Don't forget to wishlist so you will know the newest update about Aquaculture Land.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land/

Hope you guys have a beautiful day :)
Cheers!
